```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Messages -->
  <bpmn:message id="msgVisaSubmission" name="Visa application submission"/>

  <!-- Collaboration with two pools: the organisation (internal) and the representation office (external) -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="OrgPool" name="Organisation" processRef="OrgProcess"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="RepOffice" name="Representation Office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaSubmission"
                      sourceRef="SubmitVisaApplication"
                      targetRef="RepOffice"
                      messageRef="msgVisaSubmission"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Internal process -->
  <bpmn:process id="OrgProcess" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>OrganizeAccommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PrepareVisaDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>DecideMainDestination</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SelectRepresentationOffice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubmitVisaApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bank" name="Bank">
        <!-- No dedicated tasks in this simplified model; the bank activity is implicit in “Organize accommodation and open bank account”. -->
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Start process"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="OrganizeAccommodation"
               name="Organize accommodation and open bank account"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="PrepareVisaDocs"
               name="Prepare visa application documents"/>
    
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="DecideMainDestination"
                            name="Determine main travel destination?"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="SelectRepresentationOffice"
               name="Select appropriate representation office"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="SubmitVisaApplication"
               name="Submit visa application to representation office"/>
    
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Process completed"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Start_To_Organize"
                        sourceRef="Start"
                        targetRef="OrganizeAccommodation"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Organize_To_Prepare"
                        sourceRef="OrganizeAccommodation"
                        targetRef="PrepareVisaDocs"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Prepare_To_Decide"
                        sourceRef="PrepareVisaDocs"
                        targetRef="DecideMainDestination"/>
    
    <!-- Gateway outgoing flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Decide_Yes"
                        name="Main destination known"
                        sourceRef="DecideMainDestination"
                        targetRef="SelectRepresentationOffice"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Decide_No"
                        name="No main destination"
                        sourceRef="DecideMainDestination"
                        targetRef="SelectRepresentationOffice"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Select_To_Submit"
                        sourceRef="SelectRepresentationOffice"
                        targetRef="SubmitVisaApplication"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Submit_To_End"
                        sourceRef="SubmitVisaApplication"
                        targetRef="End"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
